title: The Seven Secrets of Effective Fathers Assessment & Course
tagline: Dr. Ken Canfield’s research-based Seven Secrets: assess, then grow in commitment, knowing your child, consistency, security, affirmation, loving discipline, and modeling integrity and faith.
course_purpose: Live fathers.com course already filmed: Introduction plus seven secrets and a bonus. Includes the free assessment. Wrapper animation only (cold open / keyline cards) for visual consistency with Courses 2–4; Ken’s session film stays as shot.
audience: For every dad building stronger connection and purpose. Category: Fathering. Free assessment included. Any device.
facilitator_note: FILM ALREADY SHOT · KEEP AS-IS. Course 1 in the Animation Script Bible mirrors the live Seven Secrets assessment course on fathers.com (not the older 5-session Keystone platform pack in content/fundamentals.json). Do not rewrite Ken’s sessions. Produce wrapper stills only.
bible_note: Course 1 follows https://fathers.com/courses/the-seven-secrets-of-effective-fathering-assessment-course. Platform content/fundamentals.json may still list 5 Keystone sessions; Bible Course 1 does not. Do not change the live platform repo unless trivial.
author: Dr. Ken Canfield

sessions.title: First Secret: Commitment
sessions.keyline: Present physically, emotionally, spiritually; commitment builds trust.
sessions.purpose: Establish commitment as the first secret: being present in body, heart, and spirit so trust can grow.
sessions.practical_insight: Commitment is presence that your child can count on.
sessions.summary: A father’s first and most essential role is to be present physically, emotionally, and spiritually. Commitment builds trust and lays the foundation for lasting influence.
sessions.summary_page_verbatim: A father’s first and most essential role is to be present—physically, emotionally, and spiritually. Commitment builds trust and lays the foundation for lasting influence.
sessions.one_scene: He chooses to be present in the room, in the conversation, and in the spiritual lead of the home.
sessions.in_the_room: Commitment as physical, emotional, and spiritual presence; trust as the fruit.
sessions.what_you_leave_with: You treat presence as a commitment your child can feel across all three dimensions.
sessions.practice: Name one physical, one emotional, and one spiritual way you will show up this week.
sessions.science_or_note: Commitment builds trust and lays the foundation for lasting influence.

sessions.title: Second Secret: Knowing Your Child
sessions.keyline: Unique personality, needs, and interests open deeper connection.
sessions.purpose: Train the dad to study his child’s uniqueness so parenting becomes personal, not generic.
sessions.practical_insight: Knowing your child is the door to deeper connection.
sessions.summary: Every child is unique. Understanding your child’s personality, needs, and interests opens the door to deeper connection and more meaningful parenting.
sessions.summary_page_verbatim: Every child is unique. Understanding your child’s personality, needs, and interests opens the door to deeper connection and more meaningful parenting.
sessions.one_scene: He names what makes this child different and asks a question that fits that child, not a script.
sessions.in_the_room: Personality, needs, and interests as the path to meaningful connection.
sessions.what_you_leave_with: You can name concrete traits, needs, and interests for each child.
sessions.practice: Write three specifics: one personality trait, one need, one interest for your child.
sessions.science_or_note: Understanding uniqueness opens the door to deeper connection.

sessions.summary: Children thrive on stability. Consistent actions, values, and discipline help create a secure environment where your child can grow with confidence.

sessions.what_you_leave_with: You treat consistency as security your child can feel.
sessions.practice: Pick one action, one value, and one discipline habit you will keep the same this week.
sessions.science_or_note: Children thrive on stability; consistency builds confidence.

sessions.title: Sixth Secret: Disciplining with Love
sessions.keyline: Correction that trains, bound by love, not anger.
